status: Plan B approved by Ralph 2026-10-21 ('Go with Kie all the way'): all stills nano-banana-pro, all clips Seedance 2.0 Mini reference mode on Kie. Music-only, no text (defaults, Ralph did not ask for VO or text). 2026-10-21 Ralph: redo V2S2 V8S1 V9S2 V1S2 ($0.36), remove the blue wrist strap from V3S2 V4S2 V8S2 V10S2 ($0.36, edits), accept the AI insole logo.
hand_block: Grace's hand exactly as in the hand reference photos (skin tone, slim fingers, knuckles, nails, jewellery): medium brown skin, medium-length rounded nails in soft pink with crisp white French tips, her rings (a silver heart ring and a thin gold ring; NO blue silicone band anywhere, no wristband or watch strap other than the gold bracelets) and on the wrist a chunky gold watch-link bracelet layered with a thin gold chain with tiny pearls and a small gold leaf charm. Only the hand and wrist enter from the frame edge, the sleeve cuff covers the arm, no bare forearm. Five fingers, natural skin texture. The hand GRIPS the shoe: thumb on the outside of the collar, fingers curled around it, never resting flat.
feet_block: Her bare feet have the same medium brown skin as her hands, neatly pedicured, every toenail painted glossy solid white. Her two feet always point the same way, side by side and parallel like a person standing naturally (toes toward the same edge of the frame), never in opposite directions or crossed unless described.
shoe_block: The shoe is the real Vans Premium Authentic low-top in sequin checkerboard, exactly as in the product reference sheet: a black and off-white checkerboard where ONLY the black squares are covered in raised black sequins and beads and the off-white squares are plain canvas; black leather binding around the collar with white contrast stitching; a black suede heel panel with white stitching; flat black cotton laces through four pairs of black eyelets; a small black woven VANS tab on the side; a chunky marshmallow off-white rubber sidewall; a red insole printed with a SOLID WHITE rectangle that holds the red VANS logo (white box, red letters, NOT a red box with white letters); a gum-brown waffle sole; on the back of the sidewall a small WHITE 'OFF THE WALL' skateboard label in black print (never red). The checkerboard covers the whole upper from toe to heel, with no plain panels. Keep its true low-top shape and proportions, nothing added, no other logos.
scene_suffix: Shot on a phone, natural daylight, bright, clean and neutral (no yellow, golden or dark moody tint), realistic and casual like a real person filmed it. No on-screen text, no captions, no watermark, no date stamp, nothing at any edge of the frame that is not described.
video_suffix: The shoe keeps exactly its shape, checker pattern, sequins on the black squares only, black collar, laces and marshmallow sole in every frame; sequins glint softly as the light moves. Hands and feet stay anatomically correct and keep the same skin tone, nails, polish and jewellery the whole clip. No sound. No on-screen text. No new objects, no extra hands or feet.
